## Research
- AI Crawler Blocking Study, Tranco top-500 (July 2026): https://stars-bit-ux.github.io/ai-crawler-check/study.html
  Key findings: 20% of top sites block at least one AI crawler; 11% block all
  five; 8% block at the CDN edge; 11% publish a spec-conformant llms.txt.
